explanation.text: **The Logic:** Factor investing: construct portfolios exposed to academically-documented return factors. **The Trap:** Macro and technical are subsets/adjacent approaches. **Cross-Exam Context:** XXI-B Topic 18 covers; Topic 9 uses for allocation. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Combine factors: a multi-factor model reduces drawdowns vs single-factor (e.g., value-only).
